newsitem.title: USA: Hadco says to file for share, debt offers.
newsitem.headline: Hadco says to file for share, debt offers.

text.p: Hadco Corp said Tuesday it intends to register with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission public offerings of up to 2.0 million common shares and $100 million of convertible subordinated Notes.

The company said it plans to use the majority of the net proceeds from the offerings to repay a portion of its outstanding bank debt and the remainder for general corporate purposes, which may include acquisitions.
The company did not name underwriters.

Hadco is the largest manufacturer of advanced electronic interconnect products in North America. The company's principal products are complex multilayer rigid printed circuits and backplane assemblies.
